overview.title: Overview
set.server.public_url.d: Address users reach the instance at. Used in links, emails and clone URLs.
set.server.ssh_listen.d: Address and port the built-in SSH server binds to, for example :2222.
set.server.trusted_proxies.d: Networks of reverse proxies whose forwarded client address is trusted. One CIDR per entry.
set.log.level.d: Minimum severity written to the log.
set.log.format.d: JSON suits log collectors; text is easier to read in a terminal.
set.security.registration.d: Who can create an account: anyone, only people with an invitation, or nobody.
set.security.user_directory.d: Shared limits user search to people who share a repository or organization; instance lets everyone find every active user.
set.auth.password_min_length.d: Shortest password accepted when someone sets or changes one.
set.auth.session_idle_timeout.d: A session ends after this long without activity.
set.auth.session_max_age.d: A session ends after this long, even if it is active.
set.auth.require_verified_email.d: New accounts must confirm their email address before signing in.
set.auth.login_free_failures_account.d: Failed sign-ins per account before the delay starts.
set.auth.login_free_failures_ip.d: Failed sign-ins per IP address before the delay starts.
set.auth.login_backoff_base.d: Delay applied after the free failures; it doubles on each further failure.
set.auth.login_backoff_max.d: Upper limit of the growing delay.
set.auth.actions_per_ip_per_hour: Sensitive actions per IP per hour
set.auth.actions_per_ip_per_hour.d: Rate limit for sign-up, password reset and similar requests from one address.
set.auth.require_2fa.d: Every user must set up a second factor.
set.auth.token_max_ttl.d: Longest expiry a personal access token may be given.
set.auth.invite_ttl.d: How long a sign-up invitation stays valid.
set.auth.verify_token_ttl.d: How long a verification link stays valid.
set.auth.reset_token_ttl.d: How long a password reset link stays valid.
set.mail.enabled.d: Turns outgoing email on. Without it, verification and reset mails are not sent.
set.mail.port.d: Usually 587 for STARTTLS or 465 for implicit TLS.
set.mail.tls.d: STARTTLS upgrades a plain connection, TLS is encrypted from the start, none is for local test servers only.
set.mail.username.d: Account used to sign in to the mail server. Leave empty for no authentication.
set.mail.password_file.d: Path of a file that holds the password. The password itself is never stored here.
set.mail.from.d: Address shown as the sender of outgoing mail.
set.mail.helo_name.d: Name announced to the mail server. Defaults to the host of the public URL.
set.mail.timeout.d: How long to wait for the mail server.
set.git.max_push_size.d: Largest push accepted over HTTP or SSH.
set.git.idle_timeout.d: A Git connection is closed after this long without traffic.
set.git.max_duration.d: Longest time a single Git operation may run.
set.git.requests_per_hour.d: Rate limit for Git requests from one client.
set.ssh.login_grace_time.d: Time allowed to complete the SSH handshake and sign in.
set.actions.enabled.d: Turns the CI/CD service and runner API on.
set.actions.default_actions_url.d: Where workflow steps that name an action without a host are fetched from.
set.actions.max_job_timeout.d: Upper limit for the timeout a workflow can ask for.
set.actions.runner_offline_after.d: A runner with no heartbeat for this long is shown as offline.
set.actions.registration_token_ttl.d: How long a runner registration token stays valid.
set.actions.max_jobs_per_run.d: Largest number of jobs a single workflow run may contain.
set.actions.cache_max_repo_size.d: Largest build cache a repository may keep.
set.actions.cache_ttl.d: Cache entries unused for this long are removed.
set.actions.artifact_retention.d: How long workflow artifacts are kept.
set.webhooks.allow_private.d: Let webhooks call internal network addresses. Off protects against server-side request forgery.
set.webhooks.allowed_cidrs.d: Private networks webhooks may call even when private addresses are blocked. One CIDR per entry.
set.webhooks.timeout.d: How long to wait for the receiving server.
set.webhooks.max_attempts.d: How many times a failed delivery is tried.
set.ui.default_layout.d: Layout shown to people who have not chosen one.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Everyone with an account on this instance
user.subtitle: User account
user.self: This is your own account. You cannot change your role or suspend yourself.
user.role.title: Role
user.role.hint: Admins manage the whole instance. Restricted users can sign in but cannot create repositories or organizations.
user.suspend.title: Suspend account
user.suspend.hint: Signs the user out everywhere and revokes their access tokens. Nothing is deleted.
user.suspend.dialogHint: {login} is signed out at once and cannot sign in until the account is restored.
user.unsuspend.title: Restore account
user.unsuspend.hint: The account was suspended on {date}. Restoring lets the user sign in again.
user.reset2fa.title: Reset two-factor authentication
user.reset2fa.hint: Removes the authenticator app, recovery codes and passkeys, for a user who lost their device. The user can set them up again.
user.reset2fa.dialogHint: The account will be protected by its password alone until the user sets up a second factor again. The reset is recorded in the audit log.
user.reset2fa.none: This user has no second factor set up.
user.conflict: The change was refused. You cannot demote or suspend yourself, and the last active admin must stay an admin.
invites.title: Invitations
invites.subtitle: Single-use sign-up links
invites.create.title: Invite someone
invites.create.hint: Creates a single-use sign-up link. With an email address, only that address can use it.
invites.created.title: Invitation created
invites.created.link: Share this link. It is shown only once and cannot be recovered.
invites.open.hint: Registration is currently {mode}. Invitations only matter when sign-up is limited to invited people.
invites.revoke.title: Revoke this invitation?
invites.revoke.hint: The link stops working at once.
settings.restart.title: Restart required
settings.restart.body: Saved changes apply the next time the server starts. Until then it keeps running with the previous values.
settings.locked.file: Locked in config.toml. Edit the file to change it.
settings.locked.env: Set by the environment variable {name}. Change the variable to change it.
enum.shared: Shared: only people you share something with
